description: Super Router is inspired by the community-driven Claude Code Router — the open-source tool that turned a single AI into a dynamic gateway by routing requests across models in real time. We apply the same philosophy to memecoin markets on Solana. Our Super Router aggregates live websocket data from DexScreener, Jupiter, and Birdeye, feeding it into a custom AI agent that stores, filters, and monitors high-signal tokens. The system reasons across OHLC charts on all timeframes, dynamically adapting to liquidity, momentum, and market conditions to identify optimal entry timing. What began as model routing evolved into intelligence routing — from AI workflows to real-time on-chain decision-making.
